audit_remediation.defect: Independent GitHub audit: skills.py permitted up to 3 hydrated bodies at <=4096 chars each (up to 12288 total), but OMP index.ts concatenates and slices total injected specialist text to OMP_VISIBILITY_MAX_INJECTED_CHARS=8192, so hydrated_skill_ids could claim 3 complete skills while the actual model-visible input silently truncated one.
audit_remediation.fix: skills.hydrate_plan now applies a deterministic aggregate injection budget (AGGREGATE_MAX_INJECTED_CHARS=8192, mirroring visibility-bridge.ts's OMP_VISIBILITY_MAX_INJECTED_CHARS, with a 2-char join separator) BEFORE returning hydrated_skill_ids. Candidates are accepted in selected_skill_ids (router priority) order; the first skill whose full body would exceed the running total, and every skill after it, is rejected whole with unavailable_skill_ids[id]='aggregate_budget_exceeded' -- never partially injected. visibility-bridge.ts's validateOmpVisibilityResult independently rejects (fails the whole plan open) any plan whose aggregate hydrated_instructions total exceeds the same budget, and rejects a hydrated_skill_ids/hydrated_instructions count mismatch. 0-3 selection, descriptor-first routing, lifecycle/hash checks, no-all-skills fallback, and the shipped shadow default are all unchanged.
audit_remediation.tests: tests/test_skills.py: 3 new adversarial tests (three near-limit bodies exceed budget; two near-limit bodies both fit whole; deterministic lower-priority rejection). brainstem/prime-extension/tests/visibility-bridge.test.ts: 3 new tests (aggregate-too-large whole-plan rejection; exact-budget acceptance with byte-identical bodies; hydrated_skill_ids/hydrated_instructions count-mismatch rejection).

Result: selected_skill_ids=[alpha,beta,gamma], hydrated_skill_ids=[alpha,beta] (both full 4090 chars with intact tail markers), unavailable_skill_ids={gamma: aggregate_budget_exceeded}, aggregate total 8182<=8192. Probe skills and enforced config were removed/restored afterward.
